Attention, Generals!

To kill a beast, you aim for its head. The key to victory lies in crushing the morale of the enemy! Why waste resources to occupy an entire country, when you can demoralize and defeat the opponent by conquering its center of power - the capital?

Join our brand-new Capital Rush event this weekend and fight for world domination with 99 other players! To win this event you will need to seize control over enough enemy capitals before any of your rivals do. Strike now and conquer the world!

Event Details:

Player count: 100
2x speed
Starts immediately
Free country selection
Free for all (No teams)
Point of Interest (POI) feature activated
30 POIs to win the map
No AI peace period

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30170585/bdc317b84b8a25290959f63c6c49545133d44cb4.jpg[/img]

Step into the vast battlefields of the Pacific Theater! [b]Pacific Fronts[/b] delivers high-intensity warfare across land, sea, and air. From mainland Asia to the Americas and the scattered islands of Southeast Asia, this map challenges every aspect of your strategic command. Expect fortified defenses, rapid movement, and aggressive opposition as you lead your nation through one of the fastest and fiercest event maps in Call of War. 

[b]Event Features[/b] 

[list] [*][b]12x speed[/b] - compressing weeks of battle into just [b]3 real-life days[/b][/*] [*][b]50-player map[/b] - a massive clash of rivals with no safe corners[/*] [*][b]Random country selection[/b] - adapt and conquer with whichever nation you command[/*] [*][b]Aggressive AI[/b] - neutral nations activate after Day 1, and will behave more aggressive than usual[/*] [*][b]Fortified provinces[/b] - every territory starts with bunkers and fortifications[/*] [*][b]Infrastructure upgrades[/b] - all provinces start with Level 1 infrastructure to speed up troop deployment[/*] [*][b]Naval & air industry[/b] - every nation begins with either Naval Bases or Aircraft Factories[/*] [*][b]Units ready[/b] - Cruisers and Naval Bombers are available from the start[/*] [/list] 

The Pacific War was a test of endurance, daring, and strategic depth. In [b]Pacific Fronts[/b], you will relive that struggle in fast-paced campaigns where no shore is safe and no fleet untouchable. Seize the initiative, dominate the seas, and carve your path to victory!

notes.title: Flashpoint Europe
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30170585/d585257ba5d7b4269d6f9c0dd6daca19cbe4882b.jpg[/img]


[b]HIGH COMMAND – PRIORITY BROADCAST[/b]

[b]June 26th | 0600 Hours | OPERATION FLASHPOINT[/b]

The waiting is over. The map just lit up.

[b]Flashpoint Europe[/b] is go.

This isn’t a slow push. It’s a decisive strike across the continent.

Blink, and you’ll miss a frontline shift.
Hesitate, and you’ll lose a city.
Fall behind, and you’ll be buried in the dust of a dozen moving divisions.

Our intel was right. The enemy’s scrambling. They weren’t ready for this kind of speed - but we are.

Hit fast. Hit hard. Don’t stop.

This is more than an offensive. It’s a turning point.

You trained for this moment. You’ve got the plan. You’ve got the momentum.

[b]Now move. Raise hell. And don’t look back.[/b] 

__

Flashpoint Europe is Call of War's latest event map. Running at 24x speed, one gameday passes for every hour in real time. This makes for an intense, continuous experience - like none you’ve had in Supremacy before. 

The map also features a few extra adjustments:[list][*]Rural provinces award 1 Victory Point[/*][*]Combat timers have been doubled - letting you control your armies with pinpoint accuracy, even at high speed[/*][*]Coalitions are limited to one member - only the truly relentless will survive.[/*][/list]

Join the map all weekend long by going to your games list, and joining one of the existing maps. Make sure to check your operation goals, so you don’t miss out on rewards for partaking in the spectacle.

[b]24x speed. Real-time momentum. Instant consequences.[/b]

 [b]Only the relentless survive.[/b]

notes.title: CLASSIFIED NO LONGER
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30170585/c4203c495f4f50e808b600d519111321eb8cdc2f.png[/img]

For decades, it was buried in the archives. A fragment of a campaign that never officially existed. No maps. No communiqués. Just a codename and scattered whispers from the field:

[b]F-LA/2H-OIN4 R.E.P-OE/U[/b]

Thanks to the tireless efforts of our in-house historians, the records have been pieced back together. What they describe is astonishing - a high-speed strategic gamble designed to turn the tide of war in just days. Fast deployments. Shifting frontlines. No time to regroup.

Now, for the first time ever, this campaign is being reconstructed and made playable. The battlefield is fast. The pressure is real. And only the bold will keep up.

[b]The map unlocks soon. Prepare for high intensity warfare on June 26th. [/b]

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30170585/90fb04ccab19aa91f25981c2a1f4f9d5bcf13400.jpg[/img]


[b]This week, we went full maintenance mode - tightening bolts, oiling gears, and finally taking out a few bugs that have been camping behind enemy lines for far too long.[/b]

[b]One particularly stubborn bug finally got its marching orders.[/b] Previously, promoting a unit and then issuing a delayed move command could unintentionally cancel the upgrade - without refunding the hard-earned resources spent. We’ve fixed this issue, so your promoted units will now keep their shiny new levels, no matter when you tell them to move. 

Further, a bug where searching for a player positioned last on a ranking page would [b]redirect to the wrong page[/b] has been fixed.
[list][*]Searches now display the [b]correct page[/b] containing the target player.[/*][/list]
And finally, we’ve fixed the[b]Trade Offer UI on Mobile.[/b] In the Diplomacy menu, the trade offer text previously overlapped in multiple languages on mobile devices.
[list][*]The issue has been corrected for Czech, French, Italian, Dutch, Polish, Portuguese, and Russian.
[/*][*][b]Android[/b]: Overlap at the top resolved
[/*][*][b]iOS[/b]: Message text is now properly aligned with trade icons[/*][/list]

For a complete overview of this update, please check out the [url=https://bytro.helpshift.com/hc/en/4-call-of-war/faq/574]detailed Release Notes[/url] and share your feedback with us on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/Tuqxm7yTec]Discord[/url] Server.

notes.title: Release Notes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30170585/90fb04ccab19aa91f25981c2a1f4f9d5bcf13400.jpg[/img]

[b]Manpower cost reductions - buffs for close air support - map improvements for the Arms Race event map - critical bug fix for Anti Air units.[/b]

Good news for the troops on your frontline - reinforcements are coming! [b]Manpower costs have been reduced across the board[/b], putting more boots on the ground to where you need them the most. Bigger cost reductions were applied to later unit levels, making this change more impactful in the phase of the game where Manpower becomes a major bottleneck.

Meanwhile, spies have become a bit too good at their jobs, so we’ve tightened their leash. [b]Sabotage spies can no longer trigger the “reveal all armies” action[/b], restoring some much-needed fog to the fog of war. You can still supply your HQ with vital intel by using Intelligence spies, which can trigger the “Reveal Local Armies” action in adjacent provinces. 

[img]https://www.supremacy1914.com/uploads/pics/1748340387_news_images_33905.jpg[/img]

We’ve also made some [b]key adjustments to your close air support[/b]. The introduction of ranged Anti Air has made life tough for planes that like to linger above the battlefield.
To remedy this, [b]Attack Bombers had their damage buffed[/b] against armored targets and Naval units. Get in, land your hit and get back out - now you are getting more boom for your buck! 
Additionally, [b]Tactical Bombers have received an upgrade to their Hitpoints[/b], making them better at absorbing incoming rounds. This way they can loiter longer while slowly and methodically tearing your enemies apart.

In the meantime, long ranged Strategic Bombers were thriving. They excel at delivering precise strikes against infrastructure and population morale. To reign in their efficiency, Strategic Bombers have had some of their payload taken away - [b]less bombs means less damage against buildings and province morale.[/b]

[img]https://www.supremacy1914.com/uploads/pics/1748340465_news_images_33906.jpg[/img]

Based on community feedback [b]we’ve improved the resource availability and distribution on the Arms Race map[/b]. This should lead to fairer starts, more strategic variety, and fewer moments of “why did I already run out of food again?”  

Further we fixed a bug where Anti-Air units with fire control set to “aggressive” forgot their manners: They would open fire on neutral aircraft without triggering any diplomatic consequences. Now, if you damage a neutral nation's planes, expect them to return the favor - war will be properly triggered as it should.

For a complete overview of this update, please check out the [url=https://bytro.helpshift.com/hc/en/4-call-of-war/faq/572]detailed Release Notes[/url] and share your feedback with us on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/Tuqxm7yTec]Discord[/url] Server.

Your Supremacy: Call of War Team

notes.title: A New Era Begins - Uniting Our Games & Studios
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30170585/95d6a2ff5f570f9d194656ee73e8e74357d99069.jpg[/img]

Big changes are on the horizon, and we’re excited to share them with you first! After years of collaboration, Bytro and Dorado are officially becoming one unified company. This marks a new era—a fresh start with a new look, new aspirations, and bold ideas for the future.

We are aligning our strengths, refining our goals, and setting the stage for even greater strategy gaming experiences. This transformation is about more than just a name; it’s about reinforcing our commitment to our players and ensuring that our games continue to evolve while staying true to their roots.

[previewyoutube=yrwuWk4GSwg;full][/previewyoutube]
But that’s just the beginning.

[b]A Unified Franchise: Welcome to the Supremacy Era[/b]

With our studios coming together, we are also aligning our games under one unified [b]Supremacy[/b] franchise. [b]Supremacy 1914, Call of War, and Conflict of Nations[/b] will now carry the Supremacy name—creating a recognizable brand that strengthens all of our strategy games while keeping each title’s unique identity intact.

Here’s what this means for you:

[b]Same core gameplay & mechanics[/b] – No fundamental changes to how your favorite games play.
[b]No progress loss[/b] – Everything you’ve earned stays with you.
[b]More content & improvements[/b] – A stronger foundation for future updates and community support.

[b]Rebranding: A New Look, Same Great Games[/b]

As part of this evolution, the games will receive a branding update:

[list][*][b]Supremacy 1914[/b] – Stays the same![/*][*][b]Call of War[/b] – Will transition to [b]Supremacy: Call of War 1942[/b].[/*][*][b]Conflict of Nations[/b] – Will become [b]Supremacy: World War 3[/b].[/*][/list]
This helps players instantly recognize the connections between our games while preserving their distinct gameplay and settings. Think of it like other popular game franchises—different titles, but all part of the same legendary franchise.

[b]What’s Next?[/b]

[b]New Studio Name[/b] – A single name to represent our combined strength.
[b]Unified Login[/b] – Work is underway to streamline access across all games.
[b]Shared Community[/b] – We’ll transition to a [b]single Supremacy Discord server[/b] for a stronger, more connected player base.
[b]More Games in the Future?[/b] – While nothing is official yet, this new structure paves the way for future expansions.

[b]Your Role in This Evolution[/b]

We know change can bring questions, and we’re here to answer them. This is a [b]collaborative journey[/b], and your feedback is key to making this transition smooth. Join the discussion, share your thoughts, and let’s move forward together.

More updates will follow soon—[b]stay tuned![/b]

notes.title: Release Notes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30170585/90fb04ccab19aa91f25981c2a1f4f9d5bcf13400.jpg[/img]

Today's update brings improvements to several maps, correcting errors and adding features that have been missing so far. Chief among these is the addition of rivers to the 4x speed “World at War” map. Further on the “Dawn of the Patriot” event map, we’ve adjusted some of the existing Rivers and polished roads between provinces to enhance gameplay.

Additionally, we've addressed several important bug fixes related to air combat mechanics. Patrol damage will now correctly affect province morale when the patrol circle covers the province center, even if it's outside direct attack range. We've also fixed an issue where patrolling planes would incorrectly deal defensive damage twice when an attacking plane targeted ground units within splash damage range. This has been adjusted so that defensive damage is only applied once per attack.
Lastly, a visual issue with Anti-Air units has been corrected to properly reflect that they must move into melee range to attack ground targets.

For a complete, detailed overview of this update please check out the detailed Release Notes linked below, and share your feedback with us right here on the Discord Server.

Your Call of War Team

notes.title: Battlefield Beyond
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30170585/edc42f300b7eaffa89dd84f7f2e0e69057ecde89.jpg[/img]

[b]Brand new map graphics[/b]

Call of War is sporting a new look - making the game look better than ever before. Inspired by realistic terrain, the map now has varied biomes. Cold ice is covering the poles, while the sun shines down mercilessly on the deserts of the Sahara. Mountains rise up high into the sky, while lush green plains wait for your tanks to roll through. 

A new handy map filter lets discerning commanders distinguish easily between different terrain types. And despite looking this much better, the graphics update also brings a boost to the performance, making it smoother to scroll through your territories. Check out the new visuals in any map now - and let us know what you think!

[b]Anti-Air Units are now ranged[/b]

Get ready to take your air defense to the next level! Anti-Air units now are ranged units, marked by a purple circle. Any enemy aircraft that attacks friendly units within this range will take a guaranteed hit from the AA, while all enemy planes simply passing through have a chance to take damage as well. To balance this powerful new mechanic, AA units have received a slight HP nerf, and additionally, Self-Propelled AA has a slightly shorter range than standard AA. With this update, clever positioning of your Anti-Air becomes vital for success!

[b]Country Flag Upload Disabled on Desktop[/b]

With this update, the ability to upload custom country flags, as well as changing the leader name and title, has been disabled. This change was made due to frequent player confusion and a high volume of related support requests. While flag customization was never available on mobile, this adjustment ensures a more consistent experience across platforms. We appreciate your understanding and encourage you to continue representing your nation on the battlefield in other ways!

For a complete overview of this update, please check out the [url=https://bytro.helpshift.com/hc/en/4-call-of-war/faq/561]detailed Release Notes[/url] and share your feedback with us on the [url=https://forum.callofwar.com/index.php?thread/55412]Forums[/url]  and our [url=https://discord.com/invite/pSyubBjwEu]Discord[/url] Server.

notes.title: Release Notes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30170585/90fb04ccab19aa91f25981c2a1f4f9d5bcf13400.jpg[/img]

We’re introducing a new maximum storage capacity for War Bonds! We have heard your feedback about strategies that involve stockpiling War Bonds, so we are shaking things up to keep the action flowing. With this change, players who log in daily and spend their War Bonds smartly will have an edge, rewarding active participation on the map. And it also makes gameplay more predictable - no more late game surprises about how many War Bonds your opponent might be sitting on!
Please note that this change also makes an already existing storage cap on Manpower visible. This cap was already in place before today’s update, and as such won’t impact gameplay.

Further we have fixed a critical bug surrounding embarkment and disembarkment of units. The bug allowed crafty Generals to skip the intended timer for the action. Now everything works as intended, making naval landing forces as vulnerable as they should be during the critical phases of an invasion.

For a complete overview of this update, please check out the [url=https://bytro.helpshift.com/hc/en/4-call-of-war/faq/551]detailed Release Notes[/url] and share your feedback with us on the [url=https://forum.callofwar.com/index.php?thread/55078]Forums[/url]  and our [url=https://discord.com/invite/pSyubBjwEu]Discord[/url] Server.

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30170585/90fb04ccab19aa91f25981c2a1f4f9d5bcf13400.jpg[/img]

We’ve been closely monitoring the impact of the recent Resources Reforged update. From the feedback you all provided it has become clear that there is a shortage of Oil in the early stages of the game. This is why we’ve shifted costs on some units and buildings over to consume the more abundantly available Metal instead. This evens out resource consumption across all stages of the game, leading to a smoother gameplay experience.

Also we are testing improvements to our tutorial maps. Some of our Clash of Nations tutorial maps for new players will now start at war with a neighbouring NPC country, have a rebalanced starting unit setup and a few quality of life improvements. Check out the detailed Release Notes below if you wish to know more about this. Please note that this change is still in testing, and as such only available to a selected number of new players.

Further we fixed an immersion breaking bug on the 1939 - Blitzkrieg and Road to war scenario maps. The flags for many of the countries were mixed up. Now the correct flags are displayed next to the country nametags. Patrolling air units no longer apply the wrong province morale damage, instead applying the correct 50% damage per damage tick. And finally, we fixed an annoying bug on the World at War map, where a province in Mexico paid out ten times the intended Manpower per hour.

notes.title: Resources Reforged
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30170585/2b1704a161cf69a987f83e5b1e98d5b18365a3a8.jpg[/img]

After careful consideration and four weeks of extensive testing with the community, we’re moving forward with an update to streamline the resource system in Call of War. As part of this, two resources - [b]Goods[/b] and [b]Rare Materials[/b] - will be removed from the game with the next update. 

We understand this change is significant, especially for veteran players who value the depth of a complex resource economy. Our goal is to enrich the gameplay experience for all players. By simplifying resources, the game becomes more approachable for new players, while ensuring every choice remains impactful and rewarding for experienced players.

[b]Meaningful choices and strategic depth[/b]

All provinces that produced the removed resources have been rebalanced to produce one of the remaining resources. We reworked resource production with balance in mind, making sure that the overall material output remains the same. So while the overall number of resources will change, the availability of resources to build up your nation remains the same.

 This update is not just about simplifying gameplay - it’s about evolving it to create more meaningful decisions. This is why we redistributed the production costs of units. Where previously some tech trees had a bias towards specific resources, now there is greater variety. This makes unit build choices more impactful, creating a new layer of strategic depth to be explored. Especially in team play, resource allocation within coalitions will now take on a whole new level of importance.

  [b]Adjustments based on community feedback[/b]

Thanks to feedback from our dedicated Frontline Pioneers, we've made several important adjustments to ensure the rebalance feels authentic and remains anchored in the historic setting of the game. [list][*]Production costs were fine-tuned[/*][*]Iterated on Building costs, creating more varied gameplay options[/*][*]Refined the rural production on some maps to avoid balancing issues with the various doctrines[/*][*]Rebalanced the efficiency of Urban Industry to open up exciting new opportunities for players to fuel their war machines, adding more depth to gameplay[/*][*]There was an unintended creep in Manpower costs when building units. Now the overall MP costs are on the same level as before.[/*][/list]Your input was instrumental in shaping this update, and we hope these changes create a dynamic and competitive experience for all.

[b]Booster Cards[/b]

All existing Goods and Rare Material Booster Cards in your inventory will be converted to Money Booster Cards of an equivalent value. This way you can make your own choice on which resources you want to invest in via the Stock Market. This conversion will take place in the upcoming weeks. We will follow up with more information once we start the conversion process.

Your Call of War Team

notes.title: Resources Reforged
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30170585/7afa23630e24bbc88c2f5f59e1eaf06ba124b9f8.png[/img]

We will be making important changes to the resource system in an upcoming update. [b]Two resources - Goods and Rare Materials - will be removed from the game.[/b] These resources, previously acquired by conquering provinces, will no longer be part of your war economy.

With fewer resources available, competition over the remaining three - Fuel, Food, and Steel - will become more intense, leading to heightened conflict and more meaningful economic choices. By making resources scarcer and more valuable, we give you a deeper, more rewarding strategic experience.

[img]https://www.supremacy1914.com/uploads/pics/1726739477_news_images_31814.png[/img]

As this shakes up the very fundamentals of Call of War, we want to give our loyal Frontline Pioneers plenty of time to test this update. This is why we have already made [b]the changes available in newly created beta games.[/b] So start up a new beta map, and send us your feedback in our [url=https://discord.com/invite/pSyubBjwEu]Discord[/url]. This is your opportunity to influence how we iterate on the change before it hits the live servers for all players to enjoy!

[img]https://www.supremacy1914.com/uploads/pics/1726739534_news_images_31815.png[/img]

With the removal of Goods and Rare Materials, we’ve given all maps a shake-up by redistributing the remaining resources. Discover exciting new opportunities to expand your economic might. We’ve introduced two new setups for urban production: a 2-2-2 layout, where one resource is more plentiful than the others, and a balanced 4-1-1 layout, where all resources are equally available!

[img]https://www.supremacy1914.com/uploads/pics/1726739571_news_images_31816.png[/img]

To maintain overall cost balance, we also had another look at production costs. We used this opportunity to change the resource needs for different unit types. Before, similar units all used the same resources, but now there’s a lot more variety! 

For example, now Interceptors mainly need Food, Tactical Bombers rely on Oil, and Strategic Bombers use a mix of everything.This adds a fun twist to your build orders and trading with allies - planning ahead just got a whole lot more rewarding for the discerning strategist!

We’re excited to see how you tackle these changes, and would love to hear your thoughts - make sure to share them with us on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/pSyubBjwEu]Discord[/url].

 Your Call of War Team!

notes.title: Release Notes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30170585/90fb04ccab19aa91f25981c2a1f4f9d5bcf13400.jpg[/img]

Continuing on in our efforts to finetune War Bonds, we are making more impactful changes rto Call of War’s latest resource. On all newly created maps, players will now start with 5,000 War Bonds instead of the previous 10,000. This limits the amount of havoc that War Bonds can cause in the very beginning of the game, letting players settle in better when joining a map.
Additionally, users with Premium Account will now enjoy a 20% increase to the production rate of their War Bonds. This means that the hourly production rate will go from 1,250 to 1,500, giving Premium users one additional special action per gameday.

We also fixed a bug that caused units stationed in allied territory to automatically attack instead of defending when engaged by enemies. Now, these units will correctly use their defensive combat stats.

Finally, we are in the process of implementing a moderation tool that automatically checks the newspaper for prohibited content. Please refer to our FAQ section on [url=https://bytro.helpshift.com/hc/en/4-call-of-war/]Helpshift[/url] if you have any questions about this change. 


For a complete overview of this update, please check out the [url=https://bytro.helpshift.com/hc/en/4-call-of-war/faq/531]detailed Release Notes[/url] and share your feedback with us on the [url=https://forum.callofwar.com/index.php?thread/53384]Forums[/url]  and our [url=https://discord.com/invite/pSyubBjwEu]Discord[/url] Server.

Your Call of War Team

notes.title: Balancing changes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30170585/90fb04ccab19aa91f25981c2a1f4f9d5bcf13400.jpg[/img]

Most of us have started their journey in Call of War on the European Map, and many great battles have been fought on this all time classic. So what more reason could we need to make some key changes to this timeless battlefield, making sure it can be enjoyed well into the future!

[img]https://www.supremacy1914.com/uploads/pics/1724165231_news_images_31444.png[/img]

The most striking change you’ll notice is the addition of major Rivers to the map. These create natural chokepoints all over the map, reshuffling the dynamics of troop movements and ideal placement of defensive positions. And even better, the new St Lawrence and Volga Rivers can be sailed by ships, allowing players to penetrate deep into the vast land masses at the edges of the map.
The other major change is the addition of Belarus as an NPC nation. This creates more neutral territory in central Europe. This gives the neighboring countries some much needed breathing room during the start of the map. 
Further we changed the territory of the United Kingdom to be less spread out all over the map. For this reason we turned the territories of Bermuda and Melilla into new NPC nations.

[img]https://www.supremacy1914.com/uploads/pics/1724165539_news_images_31445.png[/img]

We also made some important changes to the balancing of [b]War Bonds[/b]. We received a lot of feedback about healing being overtuned, making it too easy to save units on the retreat from ranged attacks. Therefore we’ve increased the cost of healing these units that benefit the most from this tactic: 

[*]Motorized Infantry[/*][*]Armored Cars[/*][*]Strategic Bombers[/*][*]Tactical Bombers[/*]

Further we also increased the cost of the Instant Spy Actions “Reveal Local Army” and “Country Information” by 50% to make these actions less efficient.
Finally we also reduced the amount of War Bonds available per gameday on the World at War and Free For All maps. This is a first test to see how a slower accumulation rate impacts gameplay. As always, the changes only apply to maps created after the update.

For a complete overview of this update, please check out the [url=https://bytro.helpshift.com/hc/en/4-call-of-war/faq/527]detailed Release Notes[/url] and share your feedback with us on the [url=https://forum.callofwar.com/index.php?thread/53263]Forums[/url]  and our [url=https://discord.com/invite/pSyubBjwEu]Discord[/url] Server.

notes.title: War Bonds
notes.notes:
[url=https://www.callofwar.com/game.php?bust=1#/news/:newsID=31155][img]https://www.supremacy1914.com/uploads/pics/1721298864_news_images_31155.jpg[/img][/url]

War Bonds are a new resource in the game, located in the resource bar at the top of the screen. They [b]accumulate passively over time for free.[/b] War Bonds are used for all special actions, such as speed-ups, spy actions, morale boosts, and healing your units. So all players can now enjoy them the same.
Like other resources, War Bonds are tied to each map. So take advantage of your War Bonds to enjoy Call of War to the fullest. 

[img]https://www.supremacy1914.com/uploads/pics/1721298149_news_images_31154.png[/img]

There are some key differences to other resources. War Bonds aren’t produced by provinces. That means they accumulate at the same fixed rate for all players, regardless of how big their nation has grown or what gameday it is. Additionally, War Bonds can not be looted from defeated enemy players. And finally, they are not available on the stock market, or tradeable with other players.

So you might wonder, where does this leave Gold? [b]Going forward Gold is only used to top up resources, including the new War Bonds.[/b] And of course you can still use it to unlock premium account features during map creation.

  [img]https://www.supremacy1914.com/uploads/pics/1721297531_news_images_31152.png[/img]

War Bonds are laying a strong foundation for the future of Call of War. They give us opportunities for future iterations and new features.
But most importantly, they level the playing field. War Bonds allow everyone to participate in all functions Call of War offers. This way, everyone experiences the same gameplay.

 This also adds a new layer of strategic planning. Will you use them early in the game to keep the pace high and pressure your opponents? Or are you gonna save them for a rainy day, stocking them up for a push later in the game? The choice is yours, and we are excited to see how you’ll use your newly gained options on the battlefield!

[img]https://www.supremacy1914.com/uploads/pics/1721297725_news_images_31153.png[/img]

War Bonds are going live with the next release on Tuesday, 2024-07-23! They are already available for testing in beta games, so Frontline Pioneers can dust off their entrenching tools and already do some testing.
 We have also opened [url=https://discord.gg/hcYMy3qx]a dedicated channel on our Discord server.[/url] Head there to discuss the upcoming change or ask any questions that you may have!

That is all for now Generals - we’ll see you on the battlefield!
Your Bytro Team

notes.title: Balancing changes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30170585/90fb04ccab19aa91f25981c2a1f4f9d5bcf13400.jpg[/img]

Our last update sparked quite the discussion! We enjoyed the passionate discussion and exchange of ideas, especially over on our Discord server in the dedicated balance-discussion channel. Based on your input we are lowering the cost of constructing Industry buildings, to bolster your countries strained economies. We also heard your feedback on the woes of Infantry and militia, and gave them a slight cost reduction across all levels.

To maintain the integrity of wartime negotiations, we have fixed an issue that allowed players to change to another relation from the Diplomacy menu while at war. Going forward, such changes can only be executed through trade offers, ensuring all diplomatic maneuvers are deliberate and strategic.

We've resolved an issue where grounded planes were making a hasty retreat to the nearest aerodrome when under attack by land units. They will now engage in melee combat as intended. Also if the aerodrome in that province is damaged by the land units, the plane will now turn into a transport truck for the battle.

For a complete overview of this update, please check out the [url=https://bytro.helpshift.com/hc/en/4-call-of-war/faq/510]detailed Release Notes[/url] and share your feedback with us on the [url=https://forum.callofwar.com/index.php?thread/51753]Forums[/url]  and our [url=https://discord.com/invite/pSyubBjwEu]Discord[/url] Server.

notes.title: Balancing changes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30170585/90fb04ccab19aa91f25981c2a1f4f9d5bcf13400.jpg[/img]

In this update we’re going to have a look at one of the most fundamental aspects of Call of War: [b]The Economy![/b] More specifically, we are going to change production costs for all units in the game. 

We are aiming for multiple effects with our changes:[list][*]Economic choices, and what units are prioritized in production, matter more in the early game[/*][*]We want to shine a spotlight on higher level units, so we are simplifying the access to them[/*][*]Bigger focus on preserving and upgrading already existing units, rewarding long term strategic planning.[/*][/list]
To that end, [b]we are slightly raising resource requirements for production in the early game, while lowering costs a bit in the late game.[/b] Compared to the current balancing, prices rise the most for Lvl. 1. Each following level is seeing a smaller increase. The overall tipping point happens at gameday 10, after which unit levels become progressively less and less expensive.

For a detailed, by the numbers breakdown of the changes, please head to the [url=https://bytro.helpshift.com/hc/en/4-call-of-war/faq/504]detailed Release Notes[/url].

[img]https://www.supremacy1914.com/uploads/pics/1719325556_news_images_30904.png[/img]All balancing changes are now available on newly created maps, so go test them out!

We are going to deploy more frequent balance changes so that our best and brightest commanders can show off their skills, coming up with new strategies as the battlefield evolves. To make these balancing iterations a success, [b]we are relying on your feedback.[/b] We have set up a [url=https://discord.gg/cr4DkuMn]dedicated feedback channel[/url] for everything balance related, so that you can make your voice be heard.

We are looking forward to hearing your stories from the battlefield, your thoughts on the changes or what your vision for future updates is!
 
Your Bytro Team!

notes.title: Release Notes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30170585/90fb04ccab19aa91f25981c2a1f4f9d5bcf13400.jpg[/img]

We've got a new update with some important tweaks and fixes to enhance your gameplay.

Now you can easily see what's being given and received in trades with a single glance, reducing errors and helping you spot scam trades more easily. This brings the desktop experience up to speed with what mobile players have been enjoying already.

We fixed an issue where armies couldn't engage in battles in another player's province if they had Right of Way. Now, the idle army must be defeated first before you can capture the province. No more sneaky bypasses! And we also corrected an annoying bug that prevented attack orders from being issued against neutral armies close to a border.

For a complete overview of this update, please check out the [url=https://bytro.helpshift.com/hc/en/4-call-of-war/faq/488]detailed Release Notes[/url] and share your feedback with us on the [url=https://forum.callofwar.com/index.php?thread/51261]Forums[/url]  and our [url=https://discord.com/invite/pSyubBjwEu]Discord[/url] Server.

Your Bytro Team

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30170585/20c3a5c0b137a157c0ea648af14b00c566a140d1.jpg[/img]


Generals!

In this week's event you'll only be able to rely on your own wits and skills to emerge victorious. Doing so in the regular Free For All event is already quite a challenging task, but doing so at increased game speed is truly a feat achievable by only the most competent of strategists. 

In a 100p map with the ‘anonymous round’ feature enabled and no coalitions, you will be pitted against 99 other players in a struggle for survival. The event maps will start immediately after their creation with random country selection enabled and will run at 4x speed. Should no single competitor conquer the required amount of victory points before the time is up, the player with the highest total of victory points is declared the winner, earning not only a generous victory reward, but also the right to declare themselves to be amongst the best of the best.

Good luck, Generals!

notes.title: Balancing Changes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30170585/90fb04ccab19aa91f25981c2a1f4f9d5bcf13400.jpg[/img]

Attention, General!

The previously announced changes to Spy Actions are live now. Go launch a new map and try it out! We are eager for your feedback, so make your voice heard in the dedicated feedback channel on the official Call of War [url=https://discord.com/invite/pSyubBjwEu]Discord Server[/url]

Spies are not the only gameplay that is being rebalanced. We’ve noticed that the early game can be rather slow paced, making it not very engaging to play. That’s why we are speeding up construction and research times on a number of buildings and defensive units in the early game. Refer to the [url=https://bytro.helpshift.com/hc/en/4-call-of-war/faq/485]detailed Release Notes[/url] for a complete list of the changes.

And finally some bug fixes. The flooding of two French provinces on the Operation Supremacy map has been brought under control. We’ve also fixed missing confirmation popups, tooltips, and non-functioning info buttons to enhance the overall gameplay.

Your Bytro Team

notes.title: Clandestine Conflicts
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30170585/ed03ff35060ed1e63e4d61b4edfc2d08271e53c2.jpg[/img]

Attention, General!

We’ll be rolling out some significant changes to the spy functions in Call of War. After listening to your feedback and carefully analyzing gameplay data, we are looking to improve the experience of spying and being spied upon!

Spy actions are among the most powerful tool’s at a General’s disposal. After all, knowing your enemy’s weak points is more powerful than the most advanced technology or biggest army stack. But this also means they can become a big source of frustration for the player on the receiving end. Therefore we’ll be implementing the following changes on tuesday:

[list][*][b]Disabling "Disrupt Economy"[/b] [list][*]Rationale: This action sees minimal use and doesn't significantly impact gameplay dynamics.[/list][*][b]Disabling "Decrease Morale"[/b][list][*]Rationale: Experienced players choose "Sabotage Building" for consistent results, making this action redundant.[*]Gameplay Impact: This function disrupts gameplay in a non-engaging way, as it shifts control of the revolting province randomly, making it less strategic.[/list][*][b]Disabling "Reveal Country's Armies"[/b][list][*]Rationale: This feature is too powerful, allowing players to allocate resources and units too efficiently along their entire frontline.[*]Gameplay Impact: We want to avoid unsatisfactory gameplay where one player is being “farmed” as their opponent has perfect knowledge of their armies movements.[*]Technical Impact: This feature can cause performance issues on larger maps.[/list][/list]

We also understand that these changes will affect your strategies. As this is a crucial change to one of the core mechanics of the game, we’ll be closely monitoring the impact. [b]This is an initial test phase, and we will implement additional changes as needed.[/b]  We encourage you to share your thoughts with us on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/pSyubBjwEu]Discord server[/url]. Your insights are invaluable in making Espionage more enjoyable!

We are eagerly looking forward to your tales from the battlefield, and how the new rebalanced spy actions have changed your experience. Happy Sabotaging!

Your Bytro Team

notes.title: Balancing Changes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30170585/90fb04ccab19aa91f25981c2a1f4f9d5bcf13400.jpg[/img]

Attention, General!

This buff is showing love to the big guys! Heavy tanks are getting a slight speed buff to make them more mobile on the battlefield. At the same time we are increasing their Hitpoints, making Heavy Tanks a good choice for all out assaults on your opponent’s strongholds. Further we are adjusting the Tank Destroyers, giving them a slight upgrade on their damage values, and introducing the missing terrain modifiers that were supposed to be introduced with the last balancing update. This makes showdowns with hostile tank stacks all the more exciting!

Further we cleaned up some annoying bugs. Misattributed kills are no more! Now the kill credit will always go to the unit in the army stack that dealt the highest amount of damage. Floating tooltips in the tutorial now appear in the correct location. And event and scenario images in the main menu overview are no longer displayed in the wrong aspect ratio. Enjoy them again in all of their glory!

For a complete overview of this update, please check out the [url=https://bytro.helpshift.com/hc/en/4-call-of-war/faq/482]detailed Release Notes[/url] and share your feedback with us on the [url=https://forum.callofwar.com/index.php?thread/50994]Forums[/url]  and our [url=https://discord.com/invite/pSyubBjwEu]Discord[/url] Server.

Best of luck General!

Your Bytro Team

notes.title: Birthday Celebrations
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30170585/63a76c6a6accff64d5b15cd260b727efee8b8900.png[/img]

[b]Two weeks of event maps, special shop offers and a birthday gift![/b]

How time flies when you enjoy yourself! Has it been this long already? This week, Call of War is turning nine years old. As with every year, we have planned a big birthday bash to celebrate. Get ready for a tour de force of Event maps, birthday gifts and sales for you to enjoy over the next two weeks.


[img]https://www.supremacy1914.com/uploads/pics/1714383156_news_images_30491.png[/img]

[b]Birthday Gift Operation[/b]

Join us in celebrating nine years of tense battles and daring strategies. We have a special birthday gift for you as a token of our appreciation for your loyalty and continuing support for Call of War.
 Capture a single province during the birthday celebrations and then head to the operations window to redeem your gift!

[b]Special Shop Offers[/b]

Make sure to check our shop regularly for great offers and limited time bundles! We have set up a great rotation of offers, so that you can find exactly what your arsenal needs.

[img]https://www.supremacy1914.com/uploads/pics/1714383236_news_images_30492.png[/img]

[b]Events[/b]

A new event map every two days! We've curated a selection of your most beloved maps so that we can celebrate in style. The map will change every two days, so check out the schedule below. You do not want to miss out on your favorites!

[list] [*]29th-30th April - Rush for Europe - LIVE NOW![/*]    [*]May 1st-2nd - Arms Race[/*]      [*]May 3rd-4th - Free For All - 4x[/*]     [*]May 5th-6th - Operation Supremacy[/*]     [*]May 7th-8th - All Countries All In - 4x[/*]    [*]May 9th-10th - Team Up[/*]     [*]May 11th-12th - Swift Strike[/*][/list]

   You can also join the official Call of War Discord, where you can follow our event calendar to automatically be notified when a new event map starts.

[b]Event Operation[/b]

And if the event maps alone are not enticing enough you can partake in the special Event Operation. Progress can only be made by completing objectives on any of the birthday event maps. You’ll be richly rewarded with a selection of unit cards and resource boosters. You never know when you might need that extra bit of firepower, so this is your opportunity to stock up on reserves!

[img]https://www.supremacy1914.com/uploads/pics/1714042191_news_images_30451.png[/img]

A heartfelt thank you to you, General, for accompanying us on this journey so far! When we look at our ever evolving and growing community we are filled with pride and excitement for the future. So let’s cut the birthday cake and get ready for all the countless adventures and memories that await us in the 10th year of Call of War.

Cheers!
Your Bytro Team

notes.title: Balancing Changes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30170585/90fb04ccab19aa91f25981c2a1f4f9d5bcf13400.jpg[/img]

Attention, Generals!

Great news for our Mobile Generals! Call of War's Mobile Shop has been overhauled to provide a more convenient and user-friendly experience.
As always, for the best deals head to our [url=https://bit.ly/CallOfWarPresent]Web Shop[/url] for unique offers, exclusive deals and daily gifts!

[img]https://www.supremacy1914.com/uploads/pics/1710838973_news_images_30184.jpg[/img]

We are bringing more variety to stealth gameplay. Today’s update includes a nerf to Militia, impacting their ability to operate deep behind enemy lines. At the same time, we buffed the Stealth levels of Commandos and Paratroopers, making them more resistant to the Level 3 Scout units already available when they are unlocked. 
 Further we changed Tank Destroyers. We gave them stealth and a strength bonus on Plains. This lets them meet tanks head on where they are strongest, making for exciting showdowns on the battlefield!
Please head to the <a onclick="hup.navigationHelper.openExternalURL('https://bytro.helpshift.com/hc/en/4-call-of-war/faq/477')">detailed Release Notes[/url] for the complete list of changes. And as always, these changes only apply to newly created game rounds.

When setting up a delayed march on speed maps, inputs are now using real-time values rather than in-game time. This makes setting up a delayed march much more convenient.

And good news for players on Steam! The game will no longer get stuck on an infinite loading screen!

For a complete overview of this update, please check out the [url=https://bytro.helpshift.com/hc/en/4-call-of-war/faq/477]detailed Release Notes[/url] and share your feedback with us on the [url=https://forum.callofwar.com/index.php?thread/50680]Forums[/url]  and our [url=https://discord.com/invite/pSyubBjwEu]Discord[/url] Server.

notes.title: Release Notes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30170585/90fb04ccab19aa91f25981c2a1f4f9d5bcf13400.jpg[/img]

Attention, General!

Booster Cards have been rebalanced! To make Booster Cards more intuitive to use, we have unified the values provided across Card sizes. For example, a Small Booster Card will now always deduct 15 minutes, regardless of whether it’s used to speed up construction, production or research. Similarly, using a Medium Resource Booster will now always give you 1500 units of that resource, regardless of type. 
As this means that some of your existing Cards were converted, we made sure that you don't lose any value! All your Cards have been converted to the bigger size available, meaning that you won’t miss out on valuable resources when you need them the most!

Further, we made some much needed quality of life improvements. Whether you are engaged in high stakes diplomacy, or are simply requesting some much needed resources from your allies, the newly reworked trade interface will keep you in the loop. This way, you won’t be on the wrong end of a misguided trade deal!
And to prevent mistakes even more fatal than a diplomatic mishap, we have added an indicator showing you the impact and fallout radius of nuclear weapons when selecting their target.

For a complete overview of this update, please check out the [url=https://bytro.helpshift.com/hc/en/4-call-of-war/faq/469]detailed Release Notes[/url] and share your feedback with us on the [url=https://forum.callofwar.com/index.php?thread/50151]Forums[/url]  and our [url=https://discord.com/invite/pSyubBjwEu]Discord[/url] Server.

notes.title: Tides Rising
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30170585/7b7ff5d709dc15977eaae8438c6679a17540156d.jpg[/img]

[b]The last release of the year is upon us, and oh boy… It is a big one! Get ready for the new Amphibious Valentine DD Tank, enjoy new challenges in Operations and earn free gold with the new Offerwall feature on mobile![/b]

Attention, General!

The Tides are rising - and with it they are bringing havoc and destruction. The new Amphibious Valentine DD Tank is now available in Call of War! This new offensive unit thrives when assaulting enemy coastlines. All three levels of the Amphibious Tank can be deployed at day 2, and boast impressive damage against unarmored targets. So make sure to fortify your coastlines early and keep your sentries alert. There’s a new threat looming beyond the horizon!

To earn your Amphibious Tank Unit Cards you can complete any of the new Amphibious Tank operations. To keep things challenging and fun we’ve added new tasks to complete, such as capturing provinces or even combining multiple different tasks in the same Operation. The game will automatically track your progress. 
Make sure to check the Operations window regularly to check your progress and claim your rewards! And if you want a notification for new Operations kicking off join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/pSyubBjwEu]official Discord Server[/url] and use our handy Event calendar.

[img]https://www.supremacy1914.com/uploads/pics/1702994477_news_images_29513.png[/img]

We also have a new feature for our mobile players - the Offerwall! You can complete various tasks and offers from our advertising partners to earn free Gold, enhancing your gaming experience. The Offerwall can be found under the shop and rewards icon in the app.

Finally there are some important bug fixes you need to be aware of. AI nations can no longer be attacked by players during the AI peace period. Further we fixed a bug that allowed attackers to avoid battles with allies of the defending player. Now both the attacker and the defender’s ally now have to accept peace proposals before they come into effect.

UPDATE: Due to a delay with the Release the Offerwall feature will be enabled tomorrow (2023-12-20).

For a complete overview of this update, please check out the [url=https://bytro.helpshift.com/hc/en/4-call-of-war/faq/452]detailed Release Notes[/url] and share your feedback with us on the [url=https://forum.callofwar.com/index.php?thread/49209]Forums[/url]  and our [url=https://discord.com/invite/pSyubBjwEu]Discord[/url] Server.

notes.title: Balancing Changes - 2023-11-14
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30170585/90fb04ccab19aa91f25981c2a1f4f9d5bcf13400.jpg[/img]

Attention, General!

Your feedback has been received loud and clear! We are rolling out balance changes to one of the most notorious units in Call of War: the Railroad Gun. With its combination of firepower, mobility and early availability it has become a jack of all trades that makes building other units inefficient.
 To curb the Railroad Gun’s early game power we have split it into two levels. Level 1 is a weaker version of the current unit at slightly reduced build costs. Level 2 will become available much later in the game, has greatly increased build costs and requires a Level 5 Secret Lab.
With these changes we are aiming to create some space for alternative build paths, while preserving the unit’s unique character as the wide reaching, heavy hitting king of the artillery. 
 You can check out the newly rebalanced Railroad Gun by starting a new map right now. Already existing game rounds are not affected by the changes.

We also fixed a bug that gave Pan-Asian planes an unfair advantage in air-to-air combat. Pan-Asian planes would not take defensive damage if their patrol radius only overlapped slightly with hostile planes. Now they will take the correct amount of damage, regardless of how close or far their opponent is.

And finally, we also improved the visual design of the particle effects system. Bombs and artillery shells will now cover a wider area with multiple small explosions, leading to a more natural looking visual effect. 

For a complete overview of this update, please check out the [url=https://bytro.helpshift.com/hc/en/4-call-of-war/faq/447]detailed Release Notes[/url] and share your feedback with us on the [url=https://forum.callofwar.com/index.php?thread/48565]Forums[/url]  and our [url=https://discord.com/invite/pSyubBjwEu]Discord[/url] Server.

Best of luck General!

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30170585/90fb04ccab19aa91f25981c2a1f4f9d5bcf13400.jpg[/img]

Attention, General!

We increased the upper limit of army labels and unit sprites that can be displayed at the same time. Especially on big maps in late game scenarios this limit was reached often, causing armies to stay hidden from the player’s view. Now the upper limit is calculated dynamically, depending on the size of the map and device used.

Further we fixed an issue with garrisoned units. When a garrisoned unit was in an active state, such as attacking or converting, its garrison strength  wasn’t properly applied to the province’s uprising chance. 
Finally, we fixed a formatting issue in Newspaper articles written over multiple lines. Now, texts will be formatted appropriately across separate lines or sentences as you'd expect.

notes.title: Get Ready for the Flame Tank!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30170585/73e0d5735e46a93130bae72c8a754080bf18dd13.jpg[/img]

Attention, General!

Clad in heavy armor, a new opponent approaches! Based on the historical Churchill Crocodile, this fearsome foe excels at storming fortified positions and fighting unarmored opponents.  

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=v9nNoS7e9Wk

This tank can take a beating and still push forward. Its front-mounted flamethrower disregards the protective embrace of fortifications and unleashes devastating hellfire upon unarmored foes and buildings. This makes the Flame Tank the ultimate weapon for breaching enemy defensive lines.
But be careful when deploying your Flame Tank, it is weak against heavy armored units and air attacks. So make sure to give the newest addition to your arsenal adequate protection!

[img]https://www.supremacy1914.com/uploads/pics/1695991619_news_images_28754.png[/img]

The Churchill Crocodile variant will be available for allied doctrine players. All non-allied doctrines will have access to captured variants. Do not worry, they are just as lethal as the original and come with the same capabilities and stats!

[b]New Deployment Mechanic[/b]

The Flame Tank also comes with a new deployment mechanic. It can not be researched and produced like a traditional unit, but instead will be deployed via new Unit Cards from your inventory. Unit Cards will be available as a reward for advancing through Operations. Besides the new Flame Tank, participating in Operations will also reward you with other units already existing in Call of War. For balancing reasons, deployment of units from Unit Cards come with a set of rules:

[list][*]A minimum province morale is needed to deploy.[/*][*]Once deployed, the unit enters mobilization and cannot move or attack for a while, just defend.[/*][*]Unit levels will match the unit's research level in the game round.[/*][*]You can only deploy units in your provinces.[/*][*]You cannot deploy in provinces under attack.[/*][*]You cannot deploy over units that are mobilizing.[/*][*]Units deployed from Unit Cards must comply with the day of availability. [*]The day of availability is tied to the level of the Unit Card. Higher level cards are rarer, but also more powerful. For example the Flame Tank becomes available on the following days:[list][*]Level 1 -> Day 4[*]Level 2 -> Day 8[*]Level 3 -> Day 13[/*][/list][/*][/list]

We have created an entire set of new missions that you complete simply by playing the game:

[img]https://www.supremacy1914.com/uploads/pics/1695991683_news_images_28755.png[/img]

The new tasks and Unit Cards added to Operations make this a rewarding feature for every player in Call of War. So if you have yet to give Operations a try, now is the best time to get started!

[b]Flame Tank speedround livestream[/b]

Excited and want to know more? Join us for our livestream on the 7th of October, broadcast live on the [url=https://www.youtube.com/@Bytro]official Bytro youtube channel[/url]! We’ll play a  flaming hot 144x speed round to showcase the new tank, Unit Cards and Operations!

Your Bytro Team!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30170585/b7944b50e7f550f2ede2411ee78a4018a3cd19e5.jpg[/img]

Attention, General!

Following up on the changes from the end of May, we are making further changes to the game’s balance. Thank you to all our players for the great feedback! It made us rethink our buffs to Railroad Guns. It also sparked follow-up changes to buff the Allied and Comintern doctrines.
We reverted the buffs to Railroad gun production. Now a Secret Lab at level 4 is again required to ensure efficient production.
Further, we increased the damage of Commandos, Anti-Tanks as well as Tactical and Attack Bombers. We want to strengthen units that profit from Allied and Comintern doctrine buffs to make those doctrines more competitive with their Pan-Asian and Axis counterparts.
We also buffed the movement speed of SP Anti-Air. That way motorized offensives no longer have to compromise on either speed or anti-air.

And with that, we come to the bug fixes for this week. Enjoyers of sub-surface warfare rejoice! Submarines are no longer visible even when undetected. We also fixed a bug that caused stealth units to become visible when stacked with non-stealth units.

notes.title: Operations - New Feature
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30170585/2f71eaf1a7188884bfeba3427d6dda6ecab03b78.jpg[/img]

"Amateurs talk about tactics, but professionals study logistics."
 - General Robert H. Barrow

We are very excited to present Call of War's latest feature today - Operations!

The Operations feature provides you with long-term tasks you fulfill while playing the game. We planned Operations to include a variety of different tasks that allow us to provide you with exciting challenges. Starting with simple tasks like buying something in the shop, to more complex challenges that encourage you to change your usual play style.

You can open Operations via the new icon that is displayed on the right side of your screen when you are in a game round. Clicking or tapping on it will open the Operations screen. Here you find all available Operations and an overview of your current progress with each Operation.

Operations have several Milestones that you unlock one after the other. To complete an Operation and its tasks, you have only a few weeks. Once you reach a Milestone you can claim the linked reward in the Operations section too. To progress towards a goal, you simply tackle the task presented in the Operations. You don't need to do anything else. The action will automatically be registered and accounted for any currently available Operation. Check your available Operations and adjust your gameplay accordingly to swiftly complete each Operation's goals.

Today starts the very first Operation of this brand-new feature in Call of War! We are planning on adding new tasks and goals to it. We have many great ideas for this exciting new feature and would love to hear your ideas for tasks on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/pSyubBjwEu]Discord[/url] server and on the [url=https://forum.callofwar.com/index.php?thread/46311]forums[/url].

Please note that this new feature is currently only available on mobile.

Battleships, Railroad Guns, Infantry, Paratroopers, Motorized Infantry as well as Light and Heavy Tanks all have received buffs to make them more competitive with other units in their class. We also made Rockets, Flying Bombs and Nuclear Weapons hit harder against all targets by unifying their damage dealt to ground units and buildings.
These are only the highlights of this balance pass, please check out the [url=https://bytro.helpshift.com/hc/en/4-call-of-war/faq/411]detailed Release Notes[/url] for the complete list of changes made.

Finally, it wouldn’t be a complete update without bug fixes. Units with partial stealth, such as Militia, will no longer be invisible when entering hostile territory on terrain that doesn’t provide them stealth benefits. And ranged units with an “Aggressive” fire control setting will now finish upgrades in progress, before attacking enemies in range.


For a complete overview of this update, please check out the [url=https://bytro.helpshift.com/hc/en/4-call-of-war/faq/411]detailed Release Notes[/url] and share your feedback with us on the [url=https://forum.callofwar.com/index.php?thread/46178]Forums[/url]  and our [url=https://discord.com/invite/pSyubBjwEu]Discord[/url] Server.

There’s also a birthday sale! Check out the store for an exclusive birthday offer on your next purchase. And the best part? Participating in the birthday sale automatically enters you into a raffle for [b]a further 7 grand prizes of 80,000 Gold and 8 months of Premium Account[/b], paid out at the end of the week.

 A huge thank you to our community for another fantastic year of Call of War. Eight years is a momentous milestone, and we are immensely proud of what we have achieved together. It’s humbling to see this community grow and evolve every year. So thank you, brave generals, for the great memories and all the adventures still to come!
 Cheers, and happy birthday Call of War!

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30170585/90fb04ccab19aa91f25981c2a1f4f9d5bcf13400.jpg[/img]

Release Notes - 2023-03-07

Attention Generals! 

With Call of War's previous update, new functions to the Stop button and commands when upgrading or converting were added that allowed you to cancel Convert and Upgrade orders. In your feedback on the forums and Discord you provided us with valuable feedback that you were not happy about the introduction of certain behaviours. In particular, that the feature prevented giving commands once Upgrade/Convert were started. Especially with some edge cases. We therefore decided to revert this change.
It is possible again to add actions without cancelling the Convert or Upgrading process. These actions will then be executed after the Convert or Upgrading process is complete. The Stop command can still be used to cancel the actions.

Next to that, several bugs were fixed with this update. For example, non-ranged units will no longer add extra morale damage to a province when added to an army with ranged units after this army started attacking a province.

We also solved an issue that could cause players to be flagged as inactive right before the game ends. As a result these players would not receive any reward. Since they were marked as active just moments earlier, they also don't know that it will become an issue. To avoid this problem, Victory checks run before the Day change checks now. 
Finally, we added more sorting options for provinces on mobile devices to make it easier for you to do province management. Some bugs related to the search functionality in games that occurred for some languages are also fixed.

For a complete overview of all changes, please grab something to drink and check our [url=https://bytro.helpshift.com/hc/en/4-call-of-war/faq/325]detailed Release Notes[/url] and share your feedback with us on the [url=https://forum.callofwar.com/index.php?thread/45388]Forums[/url]  and our [url=https://discord.com/invite/pSyubBjwEu]Discord[/url] Server.

Best of luck General,
Your Bytro Team

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30170585/90fb04ccab19aa91f25981c2a1f4f9d5bcf13400.jpg[/img]

Attention, General!

We hope you all arrived in the new year safely and joyful! For the first release of this year we will continue where we left off. This release brings many bug fixes, and a small but impactful quality of life change to the army details window. Let’s get started!

We got a lot of feedback concerning the unclear HP levels of armies. You can now go to the Army details: there you will find a list of the units in your army, and their exact current HP value. This will help you make better judgments on whether your army is fit for battle, or whether it needs to return to the barracks for reinforcements!

We fixed the broken Spectator Mode. Use it to scout out map layouts and strategize before joining the map yourself!
Additionally, the split army dialogue no longer accepts decimal values. Units that were being split off via decimal value got stuck in place. We also changed the behavior of setting rally points at Sea. The rally point will now path along sea routes as intended, instead of drawing a direct line to the target.

For a complete overview of this update, please check out the [url=https://bytro.helpshift.com/hc/en/4-call-of-war/faq/286]detailed Release Notes[/url] and share your feedback with us on the [url=https://forum.callofwar.com/index.php?thread/44912]Forums[/url]  and our [url=https://discord.com/invite/pSyubBjwEu]Discord[/url] Server.

Jingle bells, Generals! 
 
As the holidays are coming and warming up our lives with joy, we would like to take some time to say how much we love bringing the very joy of gaming to all of you. This year we were able to share many memorable moments. Let’s have a look at what we accomplished together: 

[list][*]We released CoW 2.0! Updating the visuals for the entire game, this change sets up Call of War for a bright future![/*][*]25,000 players responded to the call to arms when conflict broke out between Red and Blue on the [url=https://discord.com/invite/pSyubBjwEu]Call of War Discord Server[/url]. After weeks of hard fought battles, Red emerged victorious![/*][*]We launched the official Merch store. [url=https://callofwar.myspreadshop.com/all]Gear up [/url]with quality products featuring official Call of War designs![/*][*]In Spring we were able to celebrate 7 years of Call of War![/*][*]As a Premium account user you can now create 1939 Historic World War maps. So go out there and set up your very own, custom roleplay scenario![/*][*]While CoW 2.0 certainly takes the spotlight, there were tons of other changes that make Call of War better than ever: the new map ending screen, updates to the map filters, the alliance logo creator, custom flag and profile picture upload.[/*][*]To keep things fresh and engaging we fine tuned the game: winning became more rewarding when the Gold payout for victorious Generals was buffed, and several small balance adjustments were deployed.[/*][*]And let’s not forget the countless quality of life changes and bug fixes. This wouldn’t have been possible without you: a big thank you to all the tireless bug reporters, feedback fountains and idea sharers![/*][/list]

notes.title: CoW 2.0 - Part Two
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30170585/5759c2e370a0222bb3efe07422b62f139dba06d3.png[/img]

CoW 2.0 - Part Two

Attention, General!

The long wait is over! Finally the brand new CoW 2.0 map textures are here! We have redesigned all of the terrains in Call of War. With this rework we want to give you the feeling of commanding your troops through realistic terrain, drawing inspiration from military maps of the time.
Whether you fight an infantry melee in the mountains, bombard an enemy strongpoint with artillery or plan an ambush from a forest hideout, the new textures will make it look more spectacular than ever before.

The army details window also features new artwork. The artwork will change depending on the unit composition of the army. Make sure to schedule an inspection of your armies and check out their new, improved looks!
We’ve also improved the options in the map filter menu. You can now toggle unit sprites and labels on and off. This will allow you to customize your map view to your preferences. Additionally we’ve added filter options to only show friendly units, neutral units, hostile units or even a mix of all those options. These changes give you more clarity on the tactical situation while leading your troops into battle.

We’ve also fixed a lot of bugs! When a coalition leader goes inactive, the coalition leadership is now correctly handed over to the next active player. Players will no longer be able to teleport their planes from a patrol mission directly back to the airfield, as teleportation technology is not yet available. Additionally we’ve fixed multiple issues that caused units to display the wrong arrival time in the army bar.

For a complete overview of this update, please check out the [url=https://bytro.helpshift.com/hc/en/4-call-of-war/faq/254]detailed Release Notes[/url] and share your feedback with us on the [url=https://forum.callofwar.com/index.php?thread/43834]Forums [/url] and on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/pSyubBjwEu]Discord Server[/url].

We also squashed some bugs. We fixed an issue where rewarded ads didn’t pay out correctly, and starting a construction projection from the missing requirements popup window now works as intended. notes.title: Call of War 2.0 - Part One
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30170585/32d19983f536da9474f7cf009413cd17147658e5.jpg[/img]

Release Notes - 2022-07-21

[b]Call of War 2.0 - Part One[/b]

Attention, General!

Two years ago, we set out to modernize Call of War, and to bring it up to today’s strategy game standards. We decided to split the rework into two parts: A gameplay overhaul and a visual overhaul. Together with the gameplay changes of CoW1.5, today’s visual update will complete the rework. Welcome to Call of War 2.0!

CoW 2.0 makes the game more beautiful on all platforms. This starts with the menus, making it easier to browse your ongoing games while also increasing the visibility of currently ongoing events.
 In-game we added new functionalities. Should you ever get lost in your vast empire, there’s now a handy feature to pin your favorite provinces and units, allowing you to quickly select them at a later point. And if you need an overview of all your armies in one place, the new army list has you covered.
 In addition to these new features, we’ve also improved existing menu screens. Layouts were unified, making important buttons and information more accessible, such as with the now reworked province list and unit detail info panels. We also used the chance to make things more beautiful here, updating the unit detail info panel with a rendered graphic of the unit, and colorizing the historical pictures.

 [img]https://www.supremacy1914.com/uploads/pics/1658405857_news_images_24680.jpg[/img]

While we are really excited to share the new map visuals with you, we made the decision to postpone their release. During the latest rounds of testing it became increasingly clear that the new visuals, while looking great, also still affect performance on lower end devices to a degree that we're not happy with. We're always aiming to deliver high quality updates for Call of War thus, even if it means a delay, we are opting to invest the necessary time and effort to meet our own standards; especially with such a major update.
We will keep you updated on this and will release the map textures with a further update, as soon as they are truly ready.

CoW 2.0 replaces the legacy client. Do not worry though, Call of War still plays like the game you love, as the update solely improves the visual aspects of the game. You will find the new client to be much more convenient than its predecessor. Should you still find something that you think could be improved, do not hesitate to let us know on [url=https://discord.com/invite/pSyubBjwEu]Discord[/url] or the [url=https://forum.callofwar.com/index.php?thread/43347]Forums[/url].

And last but not least, we’ve also snuck in a gameplay change. Coalitions and solo players now share the same ranking. The rankings are based on who has achieved the highest percentage of their victory point goal. To easily keep track of who is in the lead, head to the victory points panel. This change also allows us to give rewards to coalitions even if they don’t finish in first place.

We’ve only covered a few of the changes made in CoW 2.0 here. For a complete list of all the changes, grab a beverage of your choice, and check out the extensive and [url=https://bytro.helpshift.com/hc/en/4-call-of-war/faq/233]detailed Release Notes[/url]!

Welcome to Call of War 2.0, and best of luck in all your battles!

Your Bytro Team

Attention, General!

Exciting news! Today we will give you a glimpse of the upcoming visual redesign of Call of War. Together with the previous gameplay changes of CoW1.5 this visual overhaul will form
the brand new [b]Call of War 2.0![/b]

The visual overhaul contains two major areas: A revamp of the user interface and a redesign of the map itself. The new map draws inspiration from military maps of the time. It makes the game more exciting and gives you the feeling of commanding your troops on a realistic strategic map with real terrain elements merged into it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30170585/95e463e83d195f9dccc0013fdced5d8c58c48485.jpg[/img]

The revamp of the user interface gives CoW 2.0 a state of the art, modern look. It makes navigating the game more intuitive by restructuring over 140 gameplay screens and menus. All adjustments were made with the platform you use in mind, whether that is on mobile or desktop. Switching between the two will become easier, with many visual elements now being shared.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30170585/56f1aa2ee3d22ea7d93f471a8c63bf7a6820b888.jpg[/img]

Call of War 2.0 is scheduled to be released on all platforms on Tuesday, July 19th.

You can already check out all of the changes by switching to the Beta-Client in your account settings on desktop.
As a Frontline Pioneer (beta tester/player) you will automatically get a taste of the new map and UI on mobile and desktop, as they will be the default version in beta games leading up to the release.

We look forward to hearing about your first experiences with the new client, until then best of luck on the battlefield!

Your Bytro team

We have postponed the planned release date for CoW 2.0 to the 20th of July. This will give us additional time for testing and QA.

Attention, General!

Today’s update contains new features for the Beta Client on desktop, as well as several bug fixes.

On the Beta Client the special skills of a unit are now highlighted in a separate section of the unit’s info window. This way you can easily look up which of your units have stealth capabilities, where they can be stationed or whether they are able to detect stealthed units.

We also fixed several bugs. The ability of players to trade their capital and core provinces was adjusted. To make matches fairer, capital cities can no longer be traded to other players. This fixes an issue where defenders were able to deny an attacker the bonuses for conquering a capital by trading the city to another player. For similar reasons, core provinces can no longer be traded away to another nation but can be traded back to the original owner should they have been conquered by another nation during a match.  Additionally, units on patrol won’t trade damage with stealth units anymore, and land units that disembark will no longer be locked in combat with sea units.

For a complete overview of this update, please check out the [url=https://bytro.helpshift.com/hc/en/4-call-of-war/faq/225]detailed Release Notes[/url] and share your feedback with us on the [url=https://forum.callofwar.com/index.php?thread/43014]Forums[/url] and our [url=https://discord.com/invite/pSyubBjwEu]Discord Server[/url].

notes.title: Call of War - 7th Anniversary!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30170585/63e3c4f0a318b31f9c4aefa058531afaba4267d8.jpg[/img]

Attention, Generals!

We have unbelievable news! The upcoming week marks the [b]7th anniversary of Call of War[/b] and will be one of celebrations!
While it is a remarkable achievement for the game in itself, we’re even more proud to see that the community is thriving and numerous as it ever was. We celebrate this occasion properly and thank every single one of you for the loyalty you showed over the years with an entire week of event maps and the opportunity to win grand prizes to top things off!

Starting Monday 2022-04-25 at 11am, you’ll be able to join event maps for 24 hours until the next event starts. In order for you to better plan ahead in case you’re already eagerly waiting for your favorite scenario to return, here is the schedule for all involved maps:

[list][*]Monday April 25: Team Up![/*][*]Tuesday April 26: Free for All[/*][*]Wednesday April 27: Speed Round![/*][*]Thursday April 28: All Countries All in[/*][*]Friday April 29: Swift Strike![/*][/list]
In addition to the event maps we will hold [b]daily raffles[/b] giving you an opportunity to win a grand prize every day of the week. You won’t need to sign up to participate in the raffle as every player that is logging in to the game on each of the respective days will automatically be added to the pool of potential winners for that day. From monday to sunday a lucky winner will be awarded a  [b]grand prize of 77.777 Gold and 7 months of Premium Account[/b]. Each day's grand prize winner will be contacted via in-game message within a few days after.

 On top of that every player will be able to benefit from a one-time 77% Gold Bonus when making a purchase, which will become available when first logging in after the celebrations started and which will then be valid for 2 hours after that. Regardless of the amount, anyone who makes use of this offer will enter a separate raffle with an  [b]additional 7 grand prizes[/b] of 77.777 Gold and 7 months of Premium Account. In short you’ll be guaranteed to gain more value for your money but also get an additional chance to increase it even further! These prizes will be paid out once the celebrations conclude. 

We want to once again express our tremendous gratitude and give a giant thank you to everyone for playing our game and being a part of this community. Without you we wouldn’t be able to celebrate this fantastic occasion. Not only is it amazing to be able to celebrate a game's 7th anniversary, but to have a vibrant player base that is as big as it ever was at this point truly makes us proud and eager to continue developing the game for years to come. 

Make sure to log in daily in order to participate in all of the events and to maximize your chances of winning one of the grand prizes. Most importantly though, make sure to celebrate and wish a  [b]Happy Birthday to Call of War![/b]

Your Bytro Team

Attention, Generals!

Today's update brings various bug fixes for Call of War in general, and the Beta client on desktop in particular. 

We changed the default sorting order of pinned provinces in the Beta client on desktop, to make it more user friendly. By clicking the "pin" icon on the left of a province in the province overview, you can pin provinces that are of high interest to you.
As you are most likely interested in finding these provinces right away, these provinces are now listed on top of the overview by default, instead of at the bottom. Should you wish to have the pinned provinces listed at the bottom though, you can still do that, by clicking on the column header to change the order.

Among the bugs that were fixed today are the missing "Add Target" button in the army bar of several units, a rounding error when displaying certain numbers in several languages, and several issues where too many icons were displayed, icons were missing, or error messages got triggered.
